definitions.explanation: The state of being superior or excellent.
The highest grade in the traditional Japanese grading system.

examples.japanese: ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{優|ゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I got an 'A' on the test.

examples.japanese: {優|ゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{争|あらそ}う→争う：01866_arasou⟧⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: They have the ability to compete for first place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{優|ゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧、{良|りょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: My grades were three A's and two B's.

examples.japanese: ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{優|ゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{競|きそ}う→競う：13767_kisou⟧。
examples.english: To compete for superiority in quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成績表|せいせきひょう}→成績表：09289_seisekihyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{優|ゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There were three A's on the report card.

examples.japanese: {全科目|ぜんかもく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{優|ゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It is difficult to get an A in every subject.

notes:
{優|ゆう} represents excellence or superiority. In the traditional Japanese academic grading system, it's the highest grade.

USAGE (grading):
- {優|ゆう}: Excellent (A)
- {良|りょう}: Good (B)
- {可|か}: Pass (C)
- ⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧: Fail (F)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧: championship, victory
- ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧: excellent, outstanding
- ⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧: priority
- ⟦{優位|ゆうい}→優位：11531_yuui⟧: superiority, advantage

NOTE: As a standalone character, ⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧ means 'gentle/kind.'
